subject: Tenant provisioning: connector validation & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moran <alice.moran@galaxy.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant provisioning: connector validation & procurement checklist

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call I wanted to capture the immediate items we need to validate on Galaxy Health's side before we schedule the tenant provisioning window: 

- Network reachability: confirm the subnet CIDR and the public egress IPs for the connector (we need both 10.XX ranges and the NAT IP block).
- TLS: provide cert chain or confirm we'll use TLS passthrough (we can accept Let's Encrypt or your CA cert bundle).
- Service account & IAM: name the specific service account you'll create for the connector and the roles (IAM principal + minimal permissions).
- Firewall rules: outbound ports 443/5222 (for control plane), and allowed inbound for health checks (TCP 8080 from our monitoring IPs).
- Data handling appendix: attach any required procurement/legal clauses and the preferred SLA term (12 vs 24 months).

I've attached a short checklist (redwood-connector-proc-checklist-v1.pdf) and our suggested minimal IAM role. Can you confirm the CIDRs and attach your latest network diagram so we can verify the NAT mapping and peering plan?

Proposed next steps:
1) You share network diagram + confirm egress IPs (by end of day Tuesday).
2) We do a quick validation call on Wednesday to vet firewall & cert details.
3) Procurement switchover: legal will receive the contract link for signatures after verification.

If the egress IPs include a changing pool, let us know — we can work with a short-lived allowlist during provisioning but will need a stable range for production.

Thanks — cc'ing Ben and Evelyn for procurement and infra ops visibility.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-connector-proc-checklist-v1.pdf (5 pages; checklist), tenant-staging-iam.yml (text)
From: Alice Moran <alice.moran@galaxy.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Galaxy Health Network Operations <netops@galaxy.health>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant provisioning: connector validation & procurement checklist

Thanks Vanessa — digging into the details and attaching the network diagram you requested. Quick answers inline: 

- CIDR ranges: 10.120.0.0/16 (app tier), 10.130.0.0/24 (integration tier). Public egress: 52.149.12.0/28 (static NAT pool).
- TLS: We'll provide the cert chain from our internal CA; we prefer TLS termination on our side and will supply the certs to you via secure transfer.
- Service account: galaxy-connector-sa@galaxy.health (we'll give it a read-only role for the asset list and a separate role for metric push).
- Firewall: We'll open outbound to your control-plane IPs listed on the diagram; inbound for health checks from 34.87.11.23 and 34.87.11.24 (both in the diagram).
- Procurement/SLA: attached is our standard MSP appendix. We're leaning to 12 months initially.

Attaching: galaxy-network-diagram-v2.pdf (2 pages), galaxy-ndas-and-sla.zip (contains our legal appendix).

We can do the validation call Wednesday 10:00 PT — does that work for your team?

Regards,
Alice Moran
Director, Infrastructure
Galaxy Health

Attachments: galaxy-network-diagram-v2.pdf (network map), galaxy-ndas-and-sla.zip (legal)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Tenant provisioning: connector validation & procurement checklist

Forwarding Alice's diagram and appendix — looks clean but a couple procurement asks before we lock the provisioning date: 

- Legal redlines: their MSP appendix has a broad indemnity clause; request: ask legal to propose language limiting indemnity to direct damages related to data exfiltration (we should not accept open-ended third-party IP risk).
- Billing cadence: Galaxy wants monthly billing; our standard for Dedicated/on-prem tenants is quarterly minimums. Can we make a 3-month pilot with monthly invoicing for the pilot period? Evelyn: can you confirm if Finance can approve a pilot monthly cadence under RC-4492?
- SLA: 12 months is fine to start; confirm the SLA uptime floor we offer for private tenants (Ben: propose 99.5% for pilot tier).

Vanessa — if you can get Alice to confirm the egress IPs are static (she listed 52.149.12.0/28) we'll align firewall prep. Also suggest we request a brief 'oncall contact' for their NetOps before the validation call.

Alice — perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround and the diagram. Confirming the plan:

1) Validation call: Wednesday 2027-02-17 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent. Please include your NetOps oncall (name and mobile) for the health-check window.
2) Proc next steps: Ben will route the MSP appendix to Legal and Finance for the pilot monthly-billing ask.
3) Technical items we will validate on the call: cert exchange process, static NAT confirmation for 52.149.12.0/28, and a quick smoke test from our staging connector to your integration tier (10.130.0.0/24).
4) Deliverables: after successful validation we'll publish a tenant runbook and send the DocuSign link for the pilot contract (RC-4492).

Attachments referenced across the thread: redwood-connector-proc-checklist-v1.pdf, galaxy-network-diagram-v2.pdf, galaxy-ndas-and-sla.zip.

Vanessa Ortiz
